code: exists_infinite_primes2 (n : ℕ) : ∃ p, n ≤ p ∧ Nat.Prime p

explanatories.Nat.Prime: This definition specifies the criterion for a natural number to be classified as prime, requiring it to be at least two and have only one and itself as divisors.

description: For any natural number, there exists a prime number greater than or equal to it.
